title: DataScience TelemetryExportMergeReport

stats.done_summary: Task completed successfully. Delivered comprehensive quarterly operational performance report analyzing telemetry data from site historian and field operations export. Key deliverables: (1) Analysis code in code/analyze_telemetry.py, (2) Five publication-quality figures in report/images/, (3) Complete report in report/report.md with methodology, results, discussion, and actionable recommendations. Key findings: perfect data correlation (r=1.0), 1,935 kWh total production, 3 data quality issues identified in field export. Recommendations include data validation improvements, load balancing optimization, and unified data platform implementation.
